avis.texte: This mask leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth without a greasy residue. It leaves my skin feeling fresh and plumps out fine lines.

I've only had this mask for a week or so, and I love it. My skin is softer, smoother, and much brighter. I've already had comments about how good my skin looks for my age. Also, the cream isn't irritating and dries very quickly.

This is a lovely lightweight mask that is not too highly perfumed and leaves skin soft and moisturized. I would have scored it five stars, but unfortunately the tube split at the bottom, so I lost quite a lot of product.
I have only used this once, but it made my skin really smooth and soft. It is yellow, so do not be alarmed when you put it on.

This is my third time buying the retinol & bakuchiol mask. It works wonderfully for my skin, especially when it feels tired and dull. The mask usually wakes it up with a radiant glow and a silky feel. Occasionally I get random spots, and these are usually gone with one overnight application. I will continue using this product because I have finally found a treatment that agrees with my skin's needs. Happy customer.
I have used the retinol & bakuchiol mask several times. It is a lovely mask, and my skin feels so clean after using it. I will definitely be buying this again.
The retinol & bakuchiol mask feels wonderful on the skin; when removed, the skin feels soft and smells beautiful.

I received this retinol & bakuchiol mask as a gift, and it is amazing. It is a creamy mask that, when left on overnight, leaves the skin feeling glowy and shiny. After the first use, I could see an improvement in my fine lines; my skin looks refreshed, glowy, and even brighter.

This retinol & bakuchiol mask from the Youth Series range suits me perfectly; this range is completely adapted to my cosmetic needs and this mask demonstrates it once again. Its pink packaging is very pretty. The texture of the mask, which is a bit like a gel, is easy to apply. The scent is divine. The result after rinsing is great. My skin says thank you!
I could not believe the difference in my skin after using the retinol & bakuchiol mask once. My skin appeared plumper and my fine lines appeared smoother.

The retinol & bakuchiol mask has a lovely fragrance and smells fresh and fruity. I have only used this mask once, as I have only just purchased it, but I was thrilled with the results. My skin looked smoother and tighter after use, and I am looking forward to including this mask in my skin regime a couple of times a week.
I'm a retinol worshipper, and adding the retinol & bakuchiol mask to my skincare regimen will complete it. It is soft, nourishing, and gentle.

This mask has a luxury feel on the skin that sinks in and leaves the skin looking plump and healthy. The instructions are different on the carton than on the tube, but otherwise, I have no complaints.
This is a lovely retinol & bakuchiol mask, and the delivery was quick.
I noticed a difference after the first use of the retinol & bakuchiol mask; I highly recommend it.

Like all of your masks, I cannot fault the retinol & bakuchiol mask. My skin feels amazing after applying it and feels so moisturized the next morning when I wash it off. There are no dry patches at all.

The retinol & bakuchiol mask is a cream that promises to provide more moisture to the skin throughout the day and is designed to help prevent wrinkles from spreading due to synthetic snake venom. It is important to note that no existing wrinkles are mitigated; however, daily use should prevent the formation of further wrinkles. Therefore, from the time you begin using it, you can try to stop the visible aging process on your face.

The retinol & bakuchiol mask worked so well! It is perfect for my skin.

This Retinol and Bakuchiol Mask has a very light and silky texture that is quickly absorbed. It does not irritate the skin, and the next day, the skin looks fresh and smooth. The product contains a fragrance that is quite strong but not unpleasant.
I loved the retinol & bakuchiol mask and was really pleased with it. It went on smoothly, and my skin felt lovely the next day.
I love this retinol & bakuchiol mask. It smelled beautiful and was easy to apply. I was expecting a slight reddening of the skin, but there was none. I will buy this product again.

The retinol & bakuchiol mask went on nicely with no adverse reaction, which often happens to me. My skin felt refreshed and soothed afterwards. I have only used it once, so I need to use it a little more to see the full effects.

I have used the retinol & bakuchiol mask once and already my skin feels so soft and smooth. I found it a little sticky when I first put it on, but it soon seemed to dry down. I could feel my skin tingling at first, but that soon stopped. The instructions for use were conflicting, though; on the box it says to leave it on for 20 minutes then remove it, while on the tube it says to leave it on overnight. I checked the website and decided to leave it on overnight.

This product is very nice, and I think it is suitable for all skin types. My skin is normal to dry. After using the retinol & bakuchiol mask, my skin was really soft and fresh. I hope to see anti-aging results in the long run.
retinol & bakuchiol mask is a great product! It smells divine and glides onto the skin, so you don't need to use a lot. I noticed a difference in my skin's appearance after only a few uses.

This is a lovely mask that is really light; you only need a little bit to cover your whole face. The smell is really nice, and in the morning, my skin felt really clean and soft. I would recommend the retinol & bakuchiol mask.

I love this retinol & bakuchiol mask; I put it on before I go to bed and it soaks in pretty quickly. The next morning, my skin is lovely, soft, and feels refreshed.
